_note: Single source for every copy-paste prompt. scripts/gen_prompts.mjs writes prompts/*.md from this file and the setup wizard imports it, so the two never drift. Edit here, then run: node scripts/gen_prompts.mjs

prompts.title: Setup
prompts.when: Once, in Claude Desktop, with the Trading Assistant folder selected. The wizard fills in your answers.
prompts.text:
Read CLAUDE.md in this folder and follow the SETUP flow exactly.
My answers from the setup wizard are below. Ask me only about anything missing or unclear,
one question at a time, with multiple-choice options where possible.
For every tool listed under tools.to_research, look up whether it has a Claude connector
or a way to export my trades, show me what you found with links, and let me confirm before you use it.
Do not change how I write my journal. Never place, modify, or suggest specific trades.

{{ANSWERS}}

prompts.title: Continue my setup
prompts.when: Stopped partway, or opening the folder again? This picks up exactly where you left off.
prompts.text:
Read CLAUDE.md in this folder, run scripts/doctor.py, and continue my Trading Assistant setup
from where I left off. Guide me one step at a time, and do everything you can yourself.

prompts.title: Morning update (scheduled)
prompts.when: Runs by itself every weekday at your brief time. Claude creates this task during setup.
prompts.text:
Read CLAUDE.md and run the MORNING_UPDATE flow for today. Finish with the brief saved and
data/data.js rebuilt. If any source fails, still produce the brief with what you have and
say what was missing at the top.

prompts.title: Morning check-in
prompts.text:
Run the CHECKIN flow from CLAUDE.md: ask me mood (1–5), sleep, and anything on my mind,
then remind me of today's risk limits and focus rule, and save my answers to today's Notion entry.

prompts.title: Log my day
prompts.when: After the close, if you'd rather talk than type your journal.
prompts.text:
Run the LOG_DAY flow from CLAUDE.md. I'll talk; you turn it into today's journal entry in
Notion in my usual format, link it to today's trades, and ask me only about missing basics
(did I follow my plan? any mistakes?).

prompts.title: Weekly review (scheduled)
prompts.when: Runs by itself on the weekend. Use it by hand any time.
prompts.text: Run the WEEKLY_REVIEW flow from CLAUDE.md for the week just ended.

prompts.title: Ask my data
prompts.when: Any question about your own trading.
prompts.text:
Using data/ and my Notion journal (see CLAUDE.md), answer: <my question>.
Show the numbers, the sample size, and which trades/journal entries you used.

prompts.title: Fix something
prompts.when: Something looks wrong or a run failed.
prompts.text:
Something's off with my Trading Assistant: <what I see>. Read CLAUDE.md, diagnose, fix it,
and tell me in plain words what you changed.

prompts.title: Add a tool
prompts.when: You started using a new app (platform, calendar, news) and want the assistant to use it.
prompts.text:
Run the ADD_TOOL flow from CLAUDE.md for: <the app I use>.
Check whether Claude has a connector for it, and if not, the best second option
(an export, a calendar file, or web search). Show me the options with links, let me pick,
then walk me through it one step at a time and update config/profile.json.
